text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHistoryInside King Tutankhamun’s Tomb, 104 Years After Its DiscoveryAn unprecedented find in the Valley of KingsDNBy David Nield7:00 AM CST on November 6, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThe discovery of King Tutankhamun’s tomb in the Valley of the Kings started with the top of a staircase. On November 4, 1922, archaeologists led by Englishman Howard Carter cleared away rubble that had built up some 3,000 years prior. They were digging for the tomb of Ramesses VI. What they found was a step leading downward.Powered By 10 ShareNextStayThis wasn’t a pioneering expedition into unknown territory. The Valley of the Kings had been extensively studied and excavated before, but Tutankhamun’s tomb had remained hidden—and relatively well protected from looters.Tutankhamun’s mask—perhaps the most famous archaeological find of all time.
